tool.name: AcpypeConvertAmberToGmx
tool.description: : This class is a wrapper of Acpype tool for the conversion of AMBER topologies to GROMACS.

param.name: input_crd_path
param.label: input INPCRD file
param.help: Path to the input coordinates file (AMBER crd). Format: [input].inpcrd

param.name: input_top_path
param.label: input TOP,PARMTOP,PRMTOP file
param.help: Path to the input topology file (AMBER ParmTop). Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_path_gro
param.label: output GRO name
param.help: Path to the GRO output file Format: [output].gro

param.name: outname_output_path_top
param.label: output TOP name
param.help: Path to the TOP output file Format: [output].top

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: basename
param.label: basename
param.help: A basename for the project (folder and output files).

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the acpype executable binary.
